### Added

- (app) [Name the deployment in usage data and allow test mode by config](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3294) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: `app.telemetrydeck.deploymentID` adds a deployment ID to every usage signal, and `app.telemetrydeck.testMode: true` files signals as test data on any host. A missing or `null` `app.telemetrydeck` now turns usage data off.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.26.0...v3.27.0
